title: Build-a-LAN

title: Packet Panic
description: Traffic is flooding in — keep the network stable by routing packets before the buffer overflows.

title: Packet Post
description: Deliver a data packet safely across the network by sending it through the right stops in order.

title: Recipe Remix — The Function Kitchen
description: Build a recipe from blocks, then call it again and again with different inputs to see what a function really does.

title: Pick the Right Slot
description: Match each data need to the question type that produces the answer shape you actually need.

title: The Counting Race
description: Race a pile of structured answers against a messy one to see why data has to be sorted before it can be counted.

title: UI/UX — Good vs Bad Examples
description: Four interactive pages showing what good UI, good UX, and their opposites look like in the wild.

title: Wordwall Activities
description: Nine interactive Wordwall games for vocabulary, concept reinforcement, and review — organised by week.
